items.title: Nordic nRF54LC10A – A tiny Bluetooth LE and 802.15.4 SoC with sub-50 nA hibernation mode
items.summary: Nordic Semiconductor recently expanded its nRF54L Series with the nRF54LC10A, a new SoC with less memory and a smaller peripheral set compared to the higher-end nRF54L15, while supporting Bluetooth LE with Channel Sounding and IEEE 802.15.4 for Thread, Zigbee, and Matter. Built on a 22nm process, the SoC combines a 128 MHz Arm Cortex-M33 processor with a multiprotocol 2.4 GHz radio. It also features a sub-50 nA hibernation mode for devices shipped with (3V) batteries installed, reducing battery drain during storage and transportation. Nordic Semiconductor nRF54LC10A specifications CPU Arm Cortex-M33 @ 128 MHz with DSP, FPU, MPU, and TrustZone 128 MHz RISC-V coprocessor (VPR) with I/O acceleration for SoftPeripherals and time-critical offload Performance – 239 CoreMark/mA, 503 CoreMark (preliminary) Memory – 192 KB RAM Storage – Up to 1012 KB NVM Wireless Bluetooth 5.4 LE with direction-finding, Bluetooth Mesh, etc. Ready for future Bluetooth releases Bluetooth Channel Sounding support for [...] The post Nordic nRF54LC10A – A tiny Bluetooth LE and 802.15.4 SoC with sub-50 nA hibernation mode appeared first on CNX Software - Embedded Systems News .
items.title_zh: Nordic推出nRF54LC10A蓝牙SoC，支持亚50nA休眠模式
items.summary_zh: Nordic扩展nRF54L系列，推出nRF54LC10A SoC，基于22nm工艺，集成128MHz Arm Cortex-M33与RISC-V协处理器，支持蓝牙5.4 LE Channel Sounding及802.15.4协议（Thread/Zigbee/Matter），具备亚50nA休眠模式，有效降低预装电池设备在库存与运输中的电量损耗。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 亚50nA休眠模式显著延长预装电池设备存储寿命，RISC-V协处理器兼顾低功耗与灵活外设加速。

items.title: CVITEK CV1842H-P-based edge AI camera module offers night vision and AI-ISP support (Crowdfunding)
items.summary: The AIMORELOGY Ovis is an open-source AI vision camera module built around the CVITEK CV1842H-P SoC, with full-color 1080p night vision and 1.5 TOPS edge AI inference in a compact modular design. It is designed for drones, robotics, security systems, smart cameras, and custom embedded vision products. The camera features a compact stacked design, with a 20 × 20 mm Core board that includes the CVITEK CV1842H-P SoC, 2 Gbit NAND flash, USB, and UART debug pads. A Sensor board with the SC235HAI image sensor connects on top and also adds Ethernet and UART interfaces. An optional CVBS board goes between the Sensor board and the Ovis Core board. AIMORELOGY Ovis specifications: Ovis Core Board SoC – CVITEK CV1842H-P CPU – 1x Arm Cortex-A53 core @ 1.1 GHz, 1x RISC-V C906 core @ 800 MHz NPU – 1.5 TOPS @ INT8 with BF16 support ISP – AI-ISP with real-time 1080p [...] The post CVITEK CV1842H-P-based edge AI camera module offers night vision and AI-ISP support (Crowdfunding) appeared first on CNX Software - Embedded Systems News .
items.title_zh: CVITEK CV1842H-P驱动开源AI相机模组Ovis，支持全彩夜视
items.summary_zh: AIMORELOGY Ovis是基于CVITEK CV1842H-P的开源AI视觉相机模组，搭载Arm Cortex-A53与RISC-V C906双核，配备1.5 TOPS NPU和AI-ISP，支持1080p全彩夜视。采用20×20mm紧凑堆叠模块化设计，适用于无人机、机器人、安防与智能相机等嵌入式视觉场景。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 开源模块化设计降低AI视觉开发门槛，1.5 TOPS算力满足多场景边缘推理需求。

items.title: Morse Micro Wi-Fi HaLow USB adapters add 802.11ah connectivity to PCs and routers
items.summary: Last year, we saw Morse Micro introduce the MM8108 Wi-Fi HaLow (802.11ah) SoC with up to 43.33 Mbps throughput, along with an MM8108-RD09 USB dongle reference design, for which we had virtually no details at the time. Morse Micro has now released USB-A and USB-C Wi-Fi HaLow adapters based on that reference design. The adapters let PCs and routers connect to 802.11ah networks through USB without a dedicated expansion card and feature an external SMA antenna delivering up to 26 dBm transmit power. Wi-Fi HaLow USB network adapter specifications: SoC – Morse Micro MM8108 32-bit RISC-V Host Applications Processor (HAP) Standard – IEEE802.11ah Wi-Fi HaLow Frequency band – 850-950 MHz (Worldwide sub-1 GHz license-exempt range) Operating Modes – Access Point (AP) and Station (STA). Channel Width – 1/2/4/8 MHz Modulation – BPSK, QPSK, 16QAM, 64QAM, 256QAM. Data rate – Up to 43.3 Mbps using 256-QAM modulation at an 8 MHz bandwidth [...] The post Morse Micro Wi-Fi HaLow USB adapters add 802.11ah connectivity to PCs and routers appeared first on CNX Software - Embedded Systems News .
items.title_zh: Morse Micro推出Wi-Fi HaLow USB适配器，内置RISC-V SoC
items.summary_zh: Morse Micro发布基于MM8108 SoC的Wi-Fi HaLow（802.11ah）USB-A和USB-C适配器，可让PC和路由器通过USB连接802.11ah网络，无需专用扩展卡。SoC内置32位RISC-V处理器，支持850–950 MHz频段、最高43.3 Mbps速率和256-QAM调制，外置SMA天线提供最高26 dBm发射功率，工作模式支持AP和STA。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 首款成熟的Wi-Fi HaLow USB方案，降低PC和路由器接入802.11ah的门槛，拓展RISC-V在无线通信领域的应用。

items.title: JetKVM Mini – A low-cost, ESP32-P4X-based KVM with Ethernet or WiFi connectivity
items.summary: JetKVM Mini is a smaller, lower-cost version of the popular JetKVM KVM over IP solution. The new model features a small information display, offers Ethernet or WiFi connectivity, and supports 1080p video capture. The main under-the-hood change is that they ditched Linux on a Rockchip RV1106G3 SoC and now rely on an ESP32-P4X (ESP32-P4 version 3.x and greater) to handle video capture, H.264 encoding, USB, and other features. The largest cost saving is removing the RAM and eMMC flash required by Linux. JetKVM Mini specifications: SoC – Espressif Systems ESP32-P4X CPU Dual-core 32-bit RISC-V HP (High-performance) CPU @ up to 400 MHz with AI instruction extension and single-precision FPU Single-RISC-V LP (Low-power) MCU core @ up to 40 MHz Memory 768 KB HP L2MEM (for dual-core CPU), 32 KB LP SRAM, 8 KB TCM (for LP MCU core) 32 MB PSRAM Storage – 128 KB HP ROM, 16 KB LP ROM [...] The post JetKVM Mini – A low-cost, ESP32-P4X-based KVM with Ethernet or WiFi connectivity appeared first on CNX Software - Embedded Systems News .
items.title_zh: JetKVM Mini发布：基于ESP32-P4X的低成本KVM方案
items.summary_zh: JetKVM Mini是JetKVM的低成本精简版，搭载Espressif ESP32-P4X SoC，集成双核32位RISC-V HP CPU（最高400 MHz，支持AI指令扩展和单精度FPU）及单核RISC-V LP MCU（最高40 MHz）。该方案取消Linux运行，去掉RAM和eMMC闪存，由ESP32-P4X直接处理视频采集、H.264编码和USB等功能，支持1080p视频采集，可选以太网或WiFi连接，并配有信息显示屏。
items.why_it_matters_zh: ESP32-P4凭借RISC-V双核与内置多媒体接口，在无Linux的轻量KVM场景中替代了原有Linux方案，显著降低成本。

items.title: ESP32-C5 Pico board follows Raspberry Pi Pico form factor, ships with on-board or external antenna
items.summary: Waveshare ESP32-C5 Pico board brings the ESP32-C5 dual-band WiFi 6, Bluetooth LE, and 802.15.4 (Zigbee/Thread) SoC to the Raspberry Pi Pico form factor. The board features an ESP32-C5-MINI-1 Series module with PCB or external antenna, two 20-pin GPIO headers, a USB-C port for power and programming, Reset and Boot buttons, and a few LEDs. It also supports Li-Ion battery charging and discharging. items.summary: The Linux kernel is having to introduce a new taint flag "TAINT_FORCED_BIND" to deal with fuzzing bots like Syzbot abusing Linux's bind/unbind sysfs functionality and generating bug reports for impractical and not at all relevant hardware/driver combinations...
items.title_zh: Linux 内核新增污点标志以应对模糊测试机器人滥用
items.summary_zh: Linux 内核新增 TAINT_FORCED_BIND 污点标志，以应对 Syzbot 等模糊测试机器人滥用 bind/unbind sysfs 功能，对不相关硬件驱动组合生成大量无效 bug 报告的问题。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该标志可帮助维护者快速识别并过滤机器人产生的噪音报告，提升内核问题处理效率。

items.title: Qualcomm Posts Open-Source GPU Driver Patches For Adreno 850 One Day After Announcement
items.summary: Yesterday Qualcomm announced the Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 as quite an interesting mobile SoC. The Qualcomm Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 features Adreno 850 graphics and already one-day later their engineers are out with initial Linux kernel patches for bringing up the A850 with the MSM kernel driver...
items.title_zh: 高通发布 Adreno 850 开源 GPU 驱动补丁
items.summary_zh: 高通在发布骁龙 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 移动 SoC 仅一天后，其工程师便提交基于 MSM 内核驱动的 Adreno 850 Linux 内核补丁，初步支持这款新 GPU。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 表明高通持续推进 Linux 平台开源 GPU 驱动支持，缩短新硬件内核适配周期。

items.title: Open-Source NVIDIA "Nouveau" Driver Sees Patches For HDMI Deep Color Support
items.summary: The Nouveau Linux kernel graphics driver for open-source NVIDIA driver support has new patches posted for enabling HDMI Deep Color support...
items.title_zh: 开源NVIDIA Nouveau驱动获得HDMI Deep Color支持补丁
items.summary_zh: 开源NVIDIA显卡驱动Nouveau近日收到一批补丁，旨在为其Linux内核图形驱动启用HDMI Deep Color支持，可呈现更宽色域和更丰富的色彩层次。
items.why_it_matters_zh: Nouveau新增HDMI Deep Color支持，补齐了开源驱动在现代显示功能上的短板。

items.title: CyboPal ONE – An AI-powered, 6-DOF robotic terminal with 27-inch 4K display that adjusts to your posture (Crowdfunding)
items.summary: CyboPal ONE is a 6-axis desktop robotic terminal designed to move a 27-inch 4K display using voice and gesture control, spatial sensing, and automatic display positioning based on the user’s position. It includes a camera, a binocular 3D sensor, and a motion sensor (IMU), and supports joint force sensing, obstacle avoidance, collision detection, and power-loss soft landing. The 6-DOF arm has a 747 mm reach and supports face tracking, manual adjustment, and saved positions. A built-in Pauli agent also provides voice control for screen positioning, application control, text input, and workflow tasks across Windows, macOS, and Linux. items.title_zh: CyboPal ONE：AI驱动的27英寸4K六轴桌面机器人终端
items.summary_zh: CyboPal ONE是一款搭载27英寸4K显示屏的六自由度桌面机器人终端，支持语音、手势和空间感知自动调节屏幕位置。设备基于Rockchip RK3588处理器，配备双目3D传感器和IMU，具备人脸追踪、避障与碰撞检测功能，并集成Pauli智能体实现跨平台语音控制。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 将AI感知与六轴机械臂结合，为桌面显示器带来主动适配人体姿态的新交互形态。

items.title: Brainchip AKD1500 M.2 and PCIe Edge AI cards, BrainBoard 1500 SPI module now available for $99 and up
items.summary: Back in November 2025, we wrote about the Brainchip AKD1500 PCIe/SPI Edge AI co-processor designed for low-power systems and delivering up to 800 GOPS at just 300 mW. In recent months, the company has launched several hardware platforms based on the ADK1500. At the end of July, Brainchip introduced the AKD1500 M.2 B+M Key development card for $129, shortly followed by the $99 BrainBoard 1500 module in August, and a few days ago, the company started selling the AKD1500 PCIe development card for $149. items.title_zh: Brainchip推出AKD1500 M.2和PCIe边缘AI开发卡 起售价99美元
items.summary_zh: Brainchip推出三款基于AKD1500神经形态协处理器的边缘AI开发平台：129美元的M.2 B+M Key开发卡、99美元的BrainBoard 1500 SPI模块及149美元的PCIe开发卡。AKD1500采用22nm FD-SOI工艺，主频5至400MHz，配备1MB片上内存，可在低于300mW功耗下提供800 GOPS算力，并支持片上自适应学习，无需云端。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 神经形态AI协处理器以极低功耗实现高算力，且支持片上学习，对低功耗边缘AI应用部署具有重要意义。
